producer_report.summary:
The planner's effort now rises one level on each revision, up to max. With the shipped setting (high) the planner runs at high, then xhigh, then max. The count is the planner calls already made in the run, so it covers critic revises and mechanical revisions alike and carries across rounds. The first call and the critic keep the configured effort. No real agent was run; the tests use the fake driver, which does not check that Claude Code accepts xhigh or max. The planner UI line now shows the effort. The invocation record already stored it.

The change is in four places:
- **`config.rs`:** a new pure function `escalated_effort(base, steps)` returns the level `steps` above `base`. It caps at the last level (max) and returns an unknown base unchanged.
- **`reading.rs`:** `agent_spec_with_effort` takes an `Option<&str>` effort override. `agent_spec` is now a wrapper that passes None, so no other caller changed.
- **`planning.rs`:** `planning_round` counts the Planner records in `closing.new_invocations`. It uses the count only when `revision` is Some, and passes `Some(&effort)` for the planner only. `critic_round` is untouched.
- **Docs:** a new "Effort on revision" paragraph and a "Built as" sentence in `job-planning.md`, the OLY-8-09 mechanism text in `spec.toml`, a CHANGELOG bullet, and a new appended D178 in `decisions.md` with a Provenance bullet. D178 has an `amended` link for D136 in `decision-links.toml` (line 5155, the line holding 'Amends D136').

I added no config key and did not touch `athena.toml`, `defaults.toml`, workflows, `records/` or any existing decisions entry.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs shows the escalation helper returns the next EFFORT_LEVELS entry per step, stays at 'max' when capped, and keeps an unknown base unchanged; `cargo test -p athena-data` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-data escalated` ran 4 tests and all passed. They are escalated_effort_moves_one_level_per_step, escalated_effort_stops_at_max, escalated_effort_keeps_an_unknown_base_unchanged and escalated_effort_follows_the_level_list_for_every_level. `cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -q` also passed for all of athena-data (217 unit tests).

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs drives a planning job with a revise verdict then an accept and asserts, from the recorded planner invocations, that the first planner call ran at the configured effort and the second at a strictly higher effort, while the critic's effort is unchanged; `cargo test -p athena-core` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: `planner_effort_rises_after_a_critic_revise` uses run_planned_records, which loads the job's invocations through Records::load. It asserts the planner efforts are [configured (high), xhigh] with the second ranking strictly higher in EFFORT_LEVELS, and both critic records equal the configured critic effort. `cargo test -p athena-core planner_effort` passed, and the full `cargo test -p athena-data -p athena-core -q` run passed (1417 passed, 1 ignored).

criteria_check.criterion: A test covers the mechanical-revision path: a plan that breaks Athena's plan rules is re-planned at a higher effort on the next pass (asserted from invocation records), and a plan that still fails stops the job as before.
criteria_check.evidence: `planner_effort_rises_across_mechanical_passes` (bad_plan then good_plan) asserts the second planner record ranks strictly above the first. `planner_effort_keeps_rising_while_a_plan_still_breaks_a_rule_and_the_stop_is_unchanged` asserts planner efforts [high, xhigh, max], state Failed, the PLANNING_STOPPED_PREFIX, 'after 2 mechanical revisions', and no critic, producer or verifier record. `planner_effort_carries_across_rounds_and_holds_at_max` asserts [high, xhigh, max, max] and PLANNING_CAP_REASON. All passed in `cargo test -p athena-core planner_effort`.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs passes an escalated effort only when `revision` is Some (a re-call), and the first call of a job uses effort_for(Role::Planner) unchanged; the diff of agent_spec in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs adds an optional effort override and every other caller passes None.
criteria_check.evidence: In planning.rs, `steps` is the earlier planner count only when `revision.is_some()` and 0 otherwise. `escalated_effort(effort_for(Role::Planner), 0)` returns the configured effort, so the first call is unchanged. The planner call passes `Some(&effort)` to `agent_spec_with_effort` and `critic_round` still calls `agent_spec`. In reading.rs, `agent_spec_with_effort` takes `effort: Option<&str>` and `agent_spec` forwards `None`. The only direct `agent_spec` calls are the other roles' existing ones, which `git diff --stat` shows unedited (no change in producer.rs, verification.rs, auditor.rs, pin.rs, audience.rs, steward.rs or hestia.rs).

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/job-planning.md describes the escalation (when it applies, step size, the cap at max), and a new appended entry in docs/decisions.md records the decision with a Provenance bullet; no existing decisions.md entry or records/ file is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: job-planning.md gains an 'Effort on revision (design)' paragraph (when it applies, one level per earlier planner call, cap at max) and a 'Built as' sentence. decisions.md gains D178 after D177 with a Provenance bullet, and the diff only adds lines after D177's last line. `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest --test ontology --test budgets --test mirrors --test job_plan` and `cargo test -p xtask --test spec --test policy` passed. records/ is absent from the working copy and untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change; no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows.
criteria_check.evidence: The CHANGELOG diff adds one bullet at the top of the first `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]`. `git diff --stat` lists only the nine deliverable files, and athena.toml, defaults.toml and the workflows are not among them.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass on the final tree (Athena's recorded check output counts).
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all --check` (no diff) and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (clean). I ran `cargo test` on athena-data, athena-core, and the athena-cli and xtask test files above (all passed). I did not run the full workspace suite.

open_issues: I did not run the full workspace `cargo test --locked` or `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. They are left to Athena's checks. The drain test's per-role effort assertions use jobs with planning off and the unchanged `agent_spec`.
No real agent was run, so whether the pinned Claude Code accepts `xhigh` and `max` for the planner is unverified, as D136 noted. D178's Tradeoff says so.
learnings: The Bash hook for the producer role allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm, so pipes into tail, grep, awk or echo are refused.
backtest.rs matches the phrase 'amends' per line and the decision-links.toml `line` must be that exact line, so the sentence has to start its own wrapped line.
Records::load works on a job that failed in planning, so a test can read planner invocation efforts from the committed records.
